thread:
Nina Park: flagging a weird pattern from this morning's q4b-compact bring-up: embedding-based recall went up on production holdout but our human-judged golden precision dropped ~3.8%. looks like dataset leakage or label drift. anyone on curation available?
Ethan Zhao: I saw the same. model logits sanity checks OK, but the mismatch between auto-metrics and golden audits is concerning.
Leah Torres: I can run a cross-fingerprint sweep. do we suspect exact dupes or paraphrase near-duplicates?
Nina Park: initial spectral+minhash run shows a lot of near-duplicates in the longctx (>1024 tokens) bucket. snippet of the check I ran:
```
# minhash clusters with token stratification
python infra/tools/hash_clusters.py --input samplebank/active --minhash-k 256 --token-buckets 64,256,1024,2048 --sim-cutoff 0.78 --out clusters.json
```
Samir Patel: 0.78 might be low for >1024; long prompts have more false positives. propose stratified thresholds: 0.86 for >1024, 0.8 for 256-1024, 0.75 for <256.
Leah Torres: agreed, running stratified pass now. also noticed golden anchors include some synthetic rewrites from earlier synthesis sprint— could be accidental reuse.
Nina Park: ugh. someone probably promoted synthesized paraphrases into anchors last quarter. that would explain precision drop.
qa-bot: job cluster-sweep-3791234567 started by Leah Torres at 2025-06-10T09:02:11Z
Leah Torres: preliminary: ~1.6% of active samplebank flagged as near-duplicate under stratified policy; most come from >1024 bucket. saving the top 600 clusters to /tmp/dup_preview_3791234567.json
Ethan Zhao: if anchors are reuses we should quarantine those anchors, snapshot current golden, and run a manual micro-audit (150 examples) before any rollouts.
Nina Park: agree. quick mitigation: run a light dedupe that only removes exact fingerprint matches and quarantines paraphrase clusters for review. Samir, can you run that?
Samir Patel: kicking off exact-fp dedupe now with `--remove-exact --quarantine-paraphrase` flags. ETA ~10m.
qa-bot: job dedupe-exact-3791234567 started by Samir Patel at 2025-06-10T09:14:03Z
Leah Torres: dedupe-exact finished: removed 0.22% exact duplicates; quarantine list size 1.4% of bank (mostly longctx). golden overlap dropped 2.3% -> 0.15%.
Nina Park: running evals on q4b-compact against the refreshed holdout. will report.
Ethan Zhao: heads up — quantization experiment q4b-compact-int8-v2 landed yesterday; it changed kernel tiling which can alter token ordering/softmax numerics slightly. if leakage isn't root cause we should fallback to int8-v1 for a compare.
Nina Park: eval results: recall normalized stable, human-judged golden precision recovered to within 0.4%. seems leakage was main issue.
Leah Torres: opened ticket MLC-4978 to make anchor promotions require explicit opt-in and block synthetic-origin anchors from automatic promotion.
Samir Patel: follow-up: schedule nightly stratified fingerprint job and add a bring-up gating check that fails CI if golden overlap > 0.5%.
Nina Park: filing the gating RFC in the infra repo. thanks team :white_check_mark:
